top_signals.title: Chief Future Officer: Eimear Bonner, Chevron | Patience Sustains Progress
top_signals.summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles Chevron CFO Eimear Bonner, who has helped lead the US energy giant to several of the most profitable quarters in its history -- and has taken steps to help the company remain resilient even if oil prices fall. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Hit spy drama ‘Vivant’ heads to the big screen
top_signals.summary: The film announcement follows a second season that sparked controversy in China over its portrayal of a fictional intelligence agency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
